newsitem.title: USA: CBOE hit with system problem, in fast market.
newsitem.headline: CBOE hit with system problem, in fast market.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Friday a systems problem hit morning trading, resulting in a floor-wide fast market.
"The CBOE is in a floor-wide fast market due to a systems problem which has resulted in intermittent delays in price and quote reporting," the exchange said in a statement.
A fast market means that option quotes brokers are seeing may not be the most current.
